_comment: Atlas Vector Search index for source_chunks.embedding.
This is an Atlas-level resource, so it cannot be created by the mongosh
schema script or by the app. Create it once per cluster:
Atlas UI:  Database > Browse Collections > sautika.source_chunks >
Search Indexes > Create Search Index > JSON Editor >
Atlas Vector Search, then paste the object below
Atlas CLI: atlas clusters search indexes create --file database/vector-index.json
numDimensions must stay equal to EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS in
src/lib/notebooks/embed.ts. Change one and you must change the other,
Until the index exists, retrieve() uses the $text keyword path, so the
name: source_chunks_vector
